integrity.finite_certificates: 14 exact signed top cycles and an exact mod-three rank lower bound, plus exhaustive automorphism enumeration; sources supplied
integrity.non_independence: Results and verification have not undergone independent mathematical audit; no third-party certification is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The new result is the full rational automorphism character on two-point unordered Heawood graph configurations, not the earlier known nonequivariant ranks.
Neither the integral automorphism-module structure nor the torsion homology of the quotient is classified.
An equivalent unindexed character calculation cannot be excluded.
One finite 14-vertex graph is covered; no higher-particle or graph-family theorem is asserted.
title: The 336-automorphism homology character of the Heawood two-point configuration space
